title: Sus Clapping
blurb: The sus clapping sound — rhythmic applause with deeply questionable energy. Context did something to this clip that can't be undone: it's clapping, but it raises questions. The meme community deploys it whenever applause feels inappropriate, ironic, or suspicious. Play it after bad performances, worse decisions, and anything that shouldn't be celebrated but is.
origin: Viral 'sus' applause from the Among Us meme era.
